d:
Dilli ki jahrili hava ke pichhe sirph gariyon ka dhuaan aur phaiktriyon se nikalne vala pradushan hi nahin hai. ismen sarkon par urne vali dhul ka bhi bara hath hai. vayu gunvatta prabandhan aayog (siekyuem) ke mutabik, dilli ke piem2.5 pradushan men dhul ki hissedari mausam ke hisab se 15 se 27 phisdi tak hoti hai.
Vahin piem10 pradushan men sarak se dobara urne vali dhul, nirman karyon aur mitti se urne vale kanon ki hissedari 58 phisdi tak pahunch sakti hai. yani dilli ki hava men maujud pradushan ka ek bara hissa hamari sarkon aur unke aaspas phaili dhul se aata hai.
